emails.subject: Streamlining operations at Rajesh India
emails.body:
Hi team,

As an enterprise managing ongoing business operations in India, keeping separate operational software aligned can be challenging. Zoho provides an integrated cloud suite—spanning CRM, HR, finance, and email—to keep all core departments working on a single platform.

How are you currently managing operational handoffs between your sales and finance teams?

Best,
